Knowledge facts: part C holds 48 fact blocks (sec04-F01 onward) from physical pages 32 to 42; part C2 holds 15 confusable and continuation blocks (sec04-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the Revised 06/2024 cover edition, the required vision, knowledge and skills tests and the knowledge test content from physical pages 1 and 15 to 17; question count, passing score and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- SC-FIT-A-COUNT — knowledge-test question count not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- SC-FIT-A-PASS — knowledge-test passing score not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- SC-FIT-A-TIME — knowledge-test time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- SC-FIT-A-FRESH — possibly newer unlinked manual upload not compared (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- SC-FIT-D-ADULTREFUSAL — adult implied-consent refusal suspension length not stated in these pages (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- SC-FIT-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- SC-FIT-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: vision form numbers, the certificate validity period and screening rules (for example sec04-F04, sec04-F07, sec04-F09) can change and must be refreshed from the SCDMV website.
